dialogues.speaker: Arakunti
dialogues.text: #Nara {NICKNAME} is singing at Festival Utsava, right? That must sound like sunshine and moonlight mixed together, sky and water pool overlapping, and dewdrops and raindrops shaking hands.

dialogues.speaker: Arakunti
dialogues.text: #Sing with Nara {NICKNAME}, Paimon. No slacking off.
